The sha256 of this manifest computed via this method is what domains/identity_domain_run9_v1.json anchor_hashes.af0 pins — it is NOT embedded as a field inside this file (self-reference is avoided the same way run9_schema.Run9IdentityDomain.content_digest() is computed outside the object it describes).

spec_sha256.verification: Recomputed independently as sha256(canonical_json(founder_specs/AF0.json content)) using af_spec.py canonical_json() convention (sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",",":"), no trailing newline) and confirmed byte-for-byte equal to the transcribed value. NOTE: this is a content-canonicalization match, NOT a literal sha256sum of the pretty-printed founder_specs/AF0.json file on disk — sha256sum(AF0.json) = d0c613e9cfcecd00f5cae5a3126de973533e9da865edbfe8d3fde14ee88bbd98, which differs because the on-disk file is indented/pretty-printed while spec_sha256 hashes the compact canonical serialization (the same relationship as af_spec.py write_json() vs genome.sha256).
